verdict.rationale: Google Drive's official upload guide documents a resumable upload type (uploadType=resumable). The guide says to use it for large files over 5 MB and when there is a high chance of network interruption, which is the core of this story. missing for 10: explicit documentation in the pack of chunk-by-chunk upload and the session-resume mechanics (e.g., querying upload status after a drop), independent or hands-on corroboration of reliability.

support.subject: As a developer, big files upload reliably — documented chunked/resumable upload sessions that survive a dropped connection

citations.quote: Resumable upload (`uploadType=resumable`): Use this upload type for large files (greater than 5 MB) and when there's a high chance of network interruption, such as when creating a file from a mobile app.
Caricamento ripristinabile (uploadType=resumable): utilizza questo tipo di caricamento per file di grandi dimensioni (superiori a 5 MB)
